0: Landfall: a tiny freshly landed Ark Hab, scorch marks still smoking, folded solar panels struggling open on a vast dim red plain; fragile warm lights in the first pressurized module, butterscotch dust sky and distant basalt ridges.
1: Foothold: inflatable habitat pods linked by bright airlocks, broad solar arrays, first greenhouse dome glowing pale green, rover tracks across rust regolith; a hard ochre sky over a working settlement.
2: Frontier: connected pressurized domes and rover convoys spread across a vast Martian basin, antenna masts link settlements, experimental lichen and a rare teal brine pool brighten the rust plain.
3: Industry: a robust colony at full shift, regolith-shielded domes, foundry stacks, power infrastructure and mass-driver rails; cargo rovers beneath a smoky amber sky.
4: Terraform: atmospheric processors and mirror towers over widening teal brine lakes, controlled clouds break the rust haze, the first blue sky and lichen green emerge.
5: New Earth: a thriving Mars valley beneath blue sky, broad reflective lakes, green terraces and lichen meadows around a glass-domed city; red ridges still visible on the horizon.
